specification: 6 V, 100 RPM target, 3 mm D shaft; all four identical
alternative: Same N20 6 V 60 RPM: slower, greater reduction; encoder version if odometry needed
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Buy one first: gearbox length, 12×10 body, shaft length/flat, stall current. Robocraze ₹225 listing is unavailable; ₹300 cap uses a different seller. Mount redesign required.

specification: 44–45 mm diameter; 3 mm D shaft; width/offset measured
alternative: 42 mm N20 wheel, or TPU tyre on redesigned D-hub
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹35 each listing; confirm whether one or pair. Set WHEEL_D to actual 44 mm; bought wheel replaces printed wheel AND separate adapter.

specification: One bridge per motor, four independent channels; 3.3 V input
alternative: Same DRV8833 at Zbotic; TB6612FNG only after stall/thermal check
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Choose real chip/carrier; full-current TI package differs from 500 mA PW package. Budget module seller claims 1.2 A; prove thermal margin. Fit new mounting holes.

specification: Header-equipped PCB-antenna DevKitC-compatible; USB; 3.3 V GPIO
alternative: WROOM-32 DevKit for control only; confirm available pins/firmware
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Evelta headline ₹910.96 incl GST; selectable board variants differ. Advertised 64×25 mm board is too long for current 58×32 tray. Use a carrier cradle.

specification: ESP32-CAM with included OV3660; 5 V board input; Wi-Fi stream
price_status: Live JSON ₹689; stock conflicts with cached page
alternative: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense camera board
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Intentional two-board budget architecture: S3 controls motors, camera streams independently. JSON says available; web snapshot says sold out. Confirm checkout and exact sensor pin map; CAM is classic ESP32, not S3.

specification: USB-UART with 3.3 V signal levels or matching ESP32-CAM-MB base
alternative: Existing USB-UART adapter with verified 3.3 V TX/RX
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Needed if camera has no USB; its board needs adequate 5 V power, not a weak 3.3 V UART regulator.

specification: I²C, exposed XSHUT; 3.3 V-safe bus and regulator-compatible input
alternative: Same VL53L0X breakout at another seller; VL53L1X with firmware/bracket change
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Default 7-bit address 0x29; initialize separately to e.g. 0x30/31/32. Buy actual breakout, not bare sensor. Three independent bracket angles.

specification: 7.4 V nominal / 8.4 V full; ~850–1000 mAh; ≥10 A verified discharge
alternative: 2S 850 mAh GNB/CNHL from hobby supplier
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: PRICE/stock/dimensions unverified. Original 62×32 opening has no floor and is probably too shallow. Obtain L/W/H and connector exits before tray redesign.

specification: 2S-capable 4.20 V/cell; mains input or include required adapter
alternative: Genuine SkyRC B6neo plus required power source
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: B3 is a lower-cost 2S/3S option (~₹332 category snapshot); verify quality/cell current. TP4056 is single-cell and cannot charge this pack.

specification: 2S → 5.5–6.0 V; ≥5 A continuous demonstrated at selected input
alternative: Two adequately rated 3 A motor regulators, one per side
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Prevents full 8.4 V from reaching 6 V motors. Must handle four starts and braking energy; choose converter/TVS clamp arrangement after tests; LM2596 labelled 3 A is not a proven 5 A solution.

specification: 2S → 5.0 V; ≥2 A continuous, low ripple
alternative: Quality 5 V 2–3 A BEC
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Separate motor and logic branches. 5 V goes to board input, not GPIO; sensor input per breakout schematic.

specification: 2S cell monitor plus firmware stop; hardware cutoff if unattended
alternative: Protected high-discharge 2S Li-ion pack with appropriate BMS
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Alarm alone does not disconnect load. Use ADC divider/cell monitor and test disconnect behaviour; confirm per-cell thresholds with pack maker.

specification: DC fuse close to battery; spare fuse; provisionally 5 A
alternative: Blade fuse holder from auto electrical shop
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Final rating from starts and measured current; must be below wire/connector safe limit. Motor wiring differs from main wiring.

specification: DC-rated ≥10 A at battery voltage; accessible
alternative: Removable XT30 disconnect + rated motor enable switch
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: CAD has no switch aperture or switch bracket; add before printing.

specification: Genuine matching male/female, insulated; battery and charging lead
alternative: Match existing pack connector using a rated adapter
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Confirm pack polarity and included plugs; JST-PH signal connectors are not main power substitutes.

specification: ~1 m each red/black 18–20 AWG main, motor 22 AWG; ~3 m 26 AWG signal
alternative: Local stranded copper cable in equivalent cross-section
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Gauge is a starting plan; validate voltage drop/current and protect against wheel rubbing. Avoid copper-clad aluminium.

specification: At least 8 locking 2/4/6-pin pairs for boards, sensors and motors
alternative: Soldered harness + heat shrink for prototype
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Use correct pitch; crimp contacts count with housings. Dupont is bench-only under vibration.

specification: 4×100 nF ceramics at motors; 2×470 µF ≥16 V driver bulk; 1×470 µF logic; 100 nF local bypass
alternative: 220–1000 µF bulk chosen from ripple/start measurements
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Bulk caps complement existing carrier caps. Add input clamp/filter for regen on buck-fed motor rail; choose clamp voltage against driver limit.

specification: ~50×70 mm, headers and screw terminals
alternative: Small custom PCB later
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Add rigid carrier mount and connector strain relief; no solderless breadboard in final mobile chassis.

specification: M3×8 (20), ×12 (12), ×16 (8), ×45 (6 if using through-bolted printed spacers); nuts (40), washers (40); M2×6 (12) + nuts/spacers
alternative: Local metric hardware, nylon spacers for electronics
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Planning quantities with spares; final screw lengths depend on corrected stack. Camera/ToF board holes may be M2, not M3; threaded metal spacers use short screws instead of long through bolts.

specification: ~32 mm at present reference; final CAD-derived length, M3 bore
alternative: Printed tubular spacer with through bolt
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current 32 mm spacers leave 2 mm gap. Once base top is fixed, length = deck underside minus base top; add matched holes.

specification: 10–15 mm hook-and-loop + foam pad
alternative: Hook-and-loop tape through new slots
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Keep straps away from terminals; new slots and solid battery floor required.

specification: Corrected PETG chassis/modules; estimated 200–300 g incl failed fit tests
alternative: PLA indoor prototype; paid print service if no printer
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Material/own-printer allowance, not a print-service quote. Wheels are purchased; do not print assembly STL. External printing may cost substantially more.

specification: S3 USB connector matched, 0.5–1 m
alternative: Existing tested data cable
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: A charge-only cable cannot program the controller.

specification: Heat shrink, cable ties, foam, labels, solder, strain relief
alternative: Existing workshop stock
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Protect all moving clearances; reserve space for antenna, regulator ventilation and plug access.

specification: 12 V, 60 RPM, quadrature A/B, 6 mm D shaft; matching four
alternative: RMCS-3012 60 RPM quadrature (~₹1500 indexed) if encoders must remain; cheap Rhino GB37 without encoder or premium Pololu #4755 as separate trade-offs
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹650 cap provisional: EngineersToy live fetch blocked. Confirm exact encoder variant, stall/current and mount/shaft offset. RMCS needs new brackets, shaft-length and 5V encoder checks; four add ≥₹3400 and may exceed budget. Nonencoder GB37 loses PID/odometry.

specification: 90–100 mm, ~20–32 mm wide; complete metal clamp hub where possible
alternative: 90 mm 6 mm-ID Robokits wheel, or 12 mm-hex RC tyre + matching 6 mm adapter
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹250/each is purchasing cap, not verified quote. Match 6 mm bore, shaft flat, hub offset, fastening pattern and retention. BO double-flat holes are not automatically compatible.

specification: Clamp or radial set screw, matches wheel holes/hex and shaft engagement
alternative: Integrated 6 mm locking wheel saves separate hub
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Skip only if R02 includes proper retention. Current printed hub cannot transmit torque reliably and wheel lacks its bolt pattern.

specification: Purchased-motor face pattern, pilot boss and chassis foot
alternative: Custom bent/cut 2–3 mm aluminium plate; Pololu 37D bracket for Pololu only
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current generic 62×62×8 flat plate needs redesign/foot; buy matched brackets or fabricate from measured drawing.

specification: Two independent motors per board; 5–30 V, 10 A continuous/channel
price_status: Live Evelta ₹1,886.82 incl GST; checkout stock ambiguous
alternative: Four BTS7960/IBT-2 single-channel modules (~₹250–450 each)
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: One channel per motor. Primary manufacturer confirms 10 A, not retailer 13 A text. No reverse-polarity protection. Current motor variant must meet channel limits.

specification: Header-equipped PCB-antenna DevKit, 8 encoder inputs, 8 drive outputs
alternative: ESP32 WROOM-32 DevKit; GPIO/PCNT redesign needed
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not use XIAO without extra pin planning; current tray holes are generic, advertised 64 mm board leaves little cable margin.

specification: 11.1 V nominal / 12.6 V full, Bonka 2200 mAh 35C, XT60
alternative: Original 4S LiFePO4 15 Ah pack after BMS/current/dimension confirmation
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Budget substitution drops nominal energy from 192 Wh to 24.42 Wh (~7.9× less). Verify C-rating authenticity; add per-cell cutoff. Charger chemistry changes.

specification: 3S 4.20 V/cell balance charging, AC input
alternative: Genuine SkyRC charger + appropriate power source
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: May be shared with compact pack; no LFP charger in this 3S build. Check actual balance connector pitch/current and three-cell readout.

specification: 3S → 5 V, ≥2 A verified, filtered
alternative: Quality 5 V BEC
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: This budget regulator is for ESP32/sensors only. Replace/add the Pi-rated supply before Pi upgrade.

specification: 3S balance connector alarm + MCU voltage stop + appropriate hardware cutoff
alternative: Pack with documented integrated high-current protection
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Typical RC LiPo has no BMS; alarm is not cutoff. Thresholds from pack spec, stop before a low cell and leave power recovery margin.

specification: Eight channels 5 V→3.3 V where needed; two 4-channel unidirectional buffers
alternative: Resistor dividers for eight verified push-pull outputs at tested encoder frequency
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Power buffers at 3.3 V and verify their inputs tolerate 5 V. Use pullups instead only when encoder outputs are confirmed open collector. Generic slow I²C shifter is not preferred for fast edges.

specification: 3.3 V-safe I²C breakout; forward-facing
alternative: HC-SR04 budget ultrasound with 5 V echo divider; VL53L1X upgrade
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: One sensor baseline, add two later. Short-range ToF is not a 360° scan or outdoor mapping sensor.

specification: Two ~330 mm rails + two crossmembers, 20×20 extrusion or angle; four corner brackets; 16 matching T-nuts/bolts if extrusion
alternative: Local 20×20 aluminium angle and drilled crossmembers
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Fabrication cap; not matching current solid SCAD bars. Angle joints use through bolts instead of T-nuts. Rotate crossmembers across rails, prepare cut/drill drawing and check flex. Flat plate only if redesigned load path needs one.

specification: Small ventilated/splash-guard box with mounting carrier
alternative: Printed PETG cover with cable grommets
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Waterproofness is unproven; ensure airflow and driver clearance, keep connectors reachable.

specification: Corrected PETG trays/brackets/bumper, ~150–250 g
alternative: Local fabrication for trays; existing filament
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Own-printer material allocation only. Excludes structural rails/wheels; external print quotes can exceed cap.

specification: DC blade holder + spare fuse; provisional 10–15 A for low-current motor variant
alternative: Higher-rated documented holder only when current/pack require it
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not freeze rating before motor stall/current-limiting test. Rating protects the chosen main wire and connector.

specification: DC-rated ≥20 A switch or accessible XT60 isolator
alternative: Rated automotive battery switch
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: A household AC switch rating is insufficient evidence for DC interrupt rating.

specification: Latching switch into hardware enable/qualified power switch path
alternative: Latching DC-rated motor power switch within easy reach
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not run battery current through signal-only mushroom contacts. If contactor is needed, budget it separately; keep controller alive for diagnostics.

specification: Insulated terminal/bar rated ≥planned fuse, ring terminals, branch terminals
alternative: Covered automotive terminal strip
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Star return for logic/encoders; no motor current through Dupont or breadboard.

specification: Battery disconnect and charger/harness; genuine matching set
alternative: Reuse included battery mating plug if supplied
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Female exposed contact side convention must not replace polarity verification; insulate every joint.

specification: Main ~1 m each red/black 16 AWG; motors ~4 m 20 AWG; signal ~5 m 26 AWG
alternative: Equivalent stranded copper from auto-electrical supplier
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Illustrative low-current JGB choice only; upgrade gauge for higher current/long runs after voltage-drop/temperature checks.

specification: 4×6-pin encoder harness sets (confirmed pitch), sensor and driver headers
alternative: Locking screw terminal signal connectors
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Buy contacts/housings/crimp tool or precrimp leads; motor pin colour assignment varies by vendor.

specification: 4×100 nF motor caps; driver bulk 2×470–1000 µF ≥25 V; 5 V bulk/local bypass
alternative: Equivalent low-ESR parts sized from measured ripple
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Motor driver regen returns energy to battery; BMS disconnection/high-full-pack conditions need clamp assessment. No single diode across bidirectional motor.

specification: M4×10 (20), ×16 (20), ×20 (12); M3×6/8/10 (12 each); locknuts/washers, electronics spacers
alternative: Local metric hardware; nylon/metal electronics spacers
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Planning counts; final joint drawing required. Motor screws must not exceed maker thread-depth limit; Pi uses M2.5 later.

specification: 15–20 mm hook-and-loop + anti-slip insulating foam
alternative: Mechanical clamp with insulated contact pads
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Tray needs solid bottom, retaining lips, matched holes and cable exit.

specification: S3 USB connector matched
alternative: Shared cable from compact build
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Later Pi↔S3 needs tested short data cable and protection against USB power backfeed.

specification: Cable ties, grommets, heat shrink, solder, labels, foam
alternative: Existing workshop stock
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: This and enclosure provide basic splash guards only, not a weatherproof rating.

specification: 4 GB is a reasonable initial ROS/vision option; 8 GB for heavier workloads
alternative: Use an existing laptop over local network; used full-working Pi 4 after test
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹9,000 is allowance, not verified current price. Changes in Pi pricing make historic ₹5–6k unsafe to assume. No Pi required for base teleoperation.

specification: Official Pi 5 active cooler, accessible airflow
alternative: Compatible fan/heatsink with proven sustained cooling
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Check cooler height, port access and fan header; protect from wheel spray.

specification: 32–64 GB endurance A1/A2 from reputable seller
alternative: Existing tested card or NVMe + HAT at higher cost
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Capacity/speed chosen to workload; image and backup. Generic unbranded cards create intermittent faults.

specification: Battery → regulated ~5.1 V ≥5 A continuous, Pi-compatible USB-C PD delivery
alternative: Qualified fused 5 V GPIO supply by experienced builder; powered USB hub as needed
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Bare 5 A buck + USB-C adapter does not prove 5 A negotiation. Test voltage at Pi under CPU+USB load; firmware USB limit must match a real supply.

specification: SLAMTEC RPLIDAR A1 kit, USB interface and cable included; revision recorded
alternative: YDLIDAR X2/X4 kit after Linux/ROS driver test; used genuine unit
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Estimate ₹8–12k class, no live quote. Model revisions vary range. Single ToF on servo is not an equivalent SLAM sensor. Plate holes must match actual device.

specification: 6-axis I²C/SPI e.g. ICM-42688 class, documented 3.3 V interface
alternative: Budget MPU6050 (~₹150–250) after authenticity/calibration checks
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Mount firmly, define orientation, timestamp and calibration; magnetometer near motors often unreliable.

specification: Camera Module 3/compatible UVC; front-facing rigid bracket
alternative: ESP32-CAM ₹689 for streaming; not a direct CSI/ROS camera replacement
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Pi 5 needs 22-pin cable to appropriate camera end; current camera slot is not a board mounting pattern.

specification: Pi 5 22-pin to camera 15-pin, correct connector orientation/length
alternative: UVC camera with USB data cable eliminates CSI cable
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Do not buy old 15→15 cable for Pi 5.

specification: M2.5 screws/nuts and four ≥6 mm spacers; carrier with 58×49 pattern
alternative: Printed insulating spacers with M2.5 hardware
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current CAD M3 3.4 mm clearance is loose; redesign for actual M2.5 board holes and board offset/ports.

specification: Left/right, exposed XSHUT
alternative: Reuse one forward sensor until needed
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Add bracket angles, two XSHUT pins; avoid duplicated addresses.

specification: Four rigid posts plus cross-braced short mast if LiDAR requires
alternative: Short aluminium tube mast with flange plates
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Current LiDAR mast is detached and incorrectly bored; add real through holes and deck supports.

specification: Short Pi↔S3 USB data cable; powered USB hub if USB budget demands
alternative: Direct short USB/UART link with documented power scheme
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Account for Pi USB current allocation, boot brownouts and supply backfeed.

specification: 4S LiFePO4 12.8 V nominal, 14.6 V-class full, 192 Wh nominal
alternative: Documented high-current 4S LFP 6–10 Ah pack; existing suitable pack
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: ₹3519 is indexed category snapshot, live page not readable. Need L/W/H, mass, discharge and whether BMS included. Not same as 3S LiPo budget battery.

specification: 4S LiFePO4, balancing/temperature, current >=actual load but <=cell/wire limits
alternative: JBD 4S LFP matched-current variant
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Conditional: buy only if bare pack needs it. Do not duplicate integrated BMS or substitute Li-ion chemistry; BMS does not replace fuse.

specification: Manufacturer-matched 4S LFP CC/CV, ~14.4–14.6 V, 2–3 A budget / 5 A faster
alternative: Lower-current LFP charger matched to selected pack
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Follow exact pack charge voltage, not nominal chemistry alone. Quartz 6 Ah listing conflicts 14.4 V spec vs 14.6 V suggested charger; resolve before ordering. Never 16.8 V Li-ion.

specification: Each: one 6 mm-ID 626-2RS (OD19×W6), redesigned carrier, one separate axle if needed, two collars and one matched coupling
alternative: Separate 8 mm axle on 608 bearings plus 6-to-8 mm coupling
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Four kits imply four bearings, four carriers, up to four axles/couplings and eight collars. Current Ø22 cavity suggests 608 (8 mm-ID), not direct 6 mm support. Freeze radial load, axle length/alignment and retention before purchase.

specification: Suitable shunt + amplifier for real branch current; 3.3 V output/bus
alternative: Bench current measurement first; higher-range hall sensor after calibration
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: Tiny module shunts/terminals may not tolerate main motor current. Optional per-channel sensors need four channels and budget.

specification: Same voltage/ratio, A/B outputs compatible with 3.3 V MCU
alternative: Keep nonencoder first build and add odometry later
compatibility_and_purchase_checks: REPLACES C01, not additional four motors. Rear encoder adds length; eight more signals; redesign wiring/mount and check stall current.
